sourceTitle: Blueprint Proses Bisnis & Modul ERP — Sensatia StockWiz

blocks.text: Blueprint ini menjawab “ERP apa yang perlu dibangun?” sebelum tim memutuskan tabel, API, atau layar.
Arah desain bisnis
Satu aliran bisnis, satu sumber kebenaran per domain, dan jejak lengkap dari bahan baku hingga penjualan.

StockWiz Next bukan kumpulan menu departemen. Ia harus menghubungkan permintaan, pembelian, penerimaan, QC, produksi, gudang, penjualan, keuangan, customer, dan tenaga kerja melalui dokumen serta event yang konsisten.
9 value streams end-to-end

13 domain utama Dengan accountable business owner. 1 inventory ledger Semua channel memakai sumber yang sama. 100% lot traceability Bahan → batch → shipment/customer. 4 wave implementasi Foundation, supply chain, commercial, corporate.

Keputusan penting: jangan menyalin struktur menu dan collection legacy menjadi desain baru. Validasi blueprint ini melalui workshop dengan warehouse, procurement, production, QC/QA, sales, finance, HR, dan manajemen.
Prinsip ini menjadi pagar saat kebutuhan baru muncul dan mencegah setiap departemen membangun sumber datanya sendiri.
Satu system of record
Setiap entitas dan saldo hanya memiliki satu pemilik. Modul lain membaca melalui contract atau read model.
Dokumen menggerakkan ledger
Stok, uang, dan status tidak diubah manual tanpa source document, actor, reason, dan approval.
Lot-first manufacturing
Lot, expiry, status kualitas, formula version, material genealogy, dan custody adalah bagian inti desain.
Maker-checker
Pembuat, approver, receiver, QC releaser, payer, dan reconciler dipisahkan sesuai nilai serta risiko.
Modular dan bertahap
Setiap vertical slice memberi nilai dan dapat digunakan tanpa menunggu seluruh ERP selesai.
Audit dan KPI by design
Setiap perubahan penting menghasilkan audit event dan metrik proses, bukan hanya log teknis.
Scope data, approval, costing, dan laporan mengikuti struktur perusahaan. Struktur ini wajib disepakati sebelum role dan transaksi dibuat.
Legal Entity
Company, currency, fiscal calendar, tax registration, chart of accounts, dan statutory reporting.
Plant & Site
Pabrik, kantor, retail/shop, distribution center, lab, dan channel digital dengan timezone serta operating calendar.
Warehouse & Location
Zone, bin, staging, receiving, quarantine, sampling, production, finished goods, damaged, dan dispatch.
Cost center & profit center
Departemen, plant, channel, brand, dan project untuk budget, actual cost, margin, serta accountability.
Work center & resource
Mixing vessel, filling line, packaging line, lab equipment, capacity, shift, calendar, dan maintenance status.
Sales organization & channel
Retail, e-commerce, wholesale, distributor, partnership, territory, price list, customer segment, dan salesperson.
Scope rule: user tidak otomatis melihat semua data karena memiliki role. Akses selalu merupakan kombinasi permission + legal entity + plant/site + warehouse/shop + department + approval limit.
Tiga belas domain saling terhubung melalui dokumen dan event; bukan melalui write langsung ke tabel/domain lain.
Transaksi hanya akan konsisten jika master data memiliki definisi, owner, lifecycle, dan uniqueness yang jelas.

blocks.text: Golden-record workflow: request → duplicate check → enrich → review → approve → publish → monitor usage → change/new version → retire. ObjectId database tidak boleh menjadi identitas bisnis lintas sistem; gunakan stable business key dan mapping registry.
Menghubungkan kebutuhan bahan dengan supplier, penerimaan, QC, hutang, dan pembayaran tanpa kehilangan tiga-way match.
Alur pembelian bahan dan jasa
Dimulai dari kebutuhan yang disetujui dan berakhir pada liability serta payment yang direkonsiliasi.

01 Purchase requisition Item/service, quantity, need date, cost center, budget. 02 RFQ & comparison Supplier quotes, price, lead time, MOQ, terms, quality. 03 Purchase order Approved commitment, version, schedule, tax, currency. 04 ASN & receiving Delivery, GRN, quantity, supplier lot, damage, documents. 05 Quarantine & QC Sample, inspect, release/reject, COA verification. 06 Supplier invoice PO–receipt–invoice three-way match dan variance. 07 Payment Due date, approval, bank control, settlement, journal.

items: PO: draft → approved → sent → partial → received → closed/cancelled
Invoice match exception dan days payable

blocks.text: Integrasi: MRP membuat planned requisition, Procurement mengubahnya menjadi PO, Warehouse membuat GRN, QC menentukan stock status, Inventory mem-post movement, dan Finance membuat accrual/AP—tanpa modul menulis data satu sama lain secara langsung.
Inventory menjadi shared operational ledger untuk bahan, bulk, WIP, finished goods, sample, dan spare part pada semua lokasi.
Alur inventory dan warehouse
Semua perpindahan memiliki source document, lot/status, from/to location, quantity/UOM, actor, dan posting time.

01 Receive GRN/return/production output ke receiving atau quarantine. 02 Inspect/status Available, quarantine, rejected, damaged, expired. 03 Putaway Directed destination by zone/bin, compatibility, capacity. 04 Reserve ATP/FEFO allocation untuk sales atau production. 05 Pick & move Scan item/lot/bin, staging, transfer, custody. 06 Issue/ship Consume ke produksi atau dispatch ke customer/shop. 07 Count/reconcile Cycle count, variance approval, reversal, audit.

items: Item, variant, lot, serial bila perlu
Pick accuracy dan order cycle time

blocks.text: Inventory movement
Append-only ledger dengan unique source key, movement type, lot/status, cost reference, dan reversal link.
Balance & reservation
Projection per dimension, di-update dalam transaction yang sama dan dapat dibangun ulang dari ledger.
Reconciliation case
Variance otomatis menjadi exception case dengan severity, evidence, owner, SLA, resolution, dan approval.
Perencanaan menerjemahkan forecast dan order menjadi keputusan produksi serta pembelian yang realistis.
Plan-to-Supply
Planning recommendation tidak otomatis menjadi transaksi tanpa review, freeze fence, dan owner.

01 Demand signal Forecast, confirmed order, promotion, launch, safety stock. 02 Net demand On-hand, reserved, open supply, lead time, expiry. 03 MPS Finished goods plan by week/site and planning fence. 04 MRP explosion Formula/BOM version, yield, scrap, lot size, MOQ. 05 Capacity check Work center, shift, maintenance, labor/skill, bottleneck. 06 Planner action Create/expedite/postpone/cancel planned orders.

items: Late supply dan material expiry risk

blocks.text: Manufacturing dirancang untuk batch skincare: formula berversi, weighing, mixing, bulk, filling, packing, yield, dan electronic batch record.
Alur produksi batch
Hanya material berstatus released, lot valid, dan formula efektif yang boleh digunakan.

01 Production order Item, batch size, formula/routing version, due date. 02 Material staging FEFO allocation, pick list, issue reservation. 03 Weighing Scan material/lot, target/tolerance, scale/operator. 04 Mixing/process Equipment, parameter, time, temperature, in-process checks. 05 Bulk output Actual yield, bulk lot, sample, quarantine, loss. 06 Fill & pack Packaging issue, line clearance, FG lot, reconciliation. 07 Close order Variance, scrap/rework, labor/machine, cost, approval.

items: Material lot genealogy dan actual quantity
Backflush hanya untuk item yang diizinkan

blocks.text: Genealogy minimum: setiap finished-goods lot harus dapat ditelusuri ke bulk lot, semua raw/packaging lots, formula/specification version, production order, work center, operator, QC results, dan shipment/customer yang menerimanya.
QC melakukan pengujian; QA memegang disposition dan sistem mutu. Status kualitas langsung mengendalikan apakah stok boleh dipakai atau dijual.
Quality lifecycle
Dari inspection lot sampai release, deviation, CAPA, complaint, dan recall.

01 Inspection lot Dibuat dari receipt, production stage/output, atau complaint. 02 Sample Sampling plan, chain of custody, sample label, retention. 03 Test result Parameter, method, instrument, analyst, result, attachment. 04 Review Specification comparison, OOS/OOT, second review. 05 Disposition Release, reject, conditional, rework, return, destroy. 06 CAPA Investigation, root cause, action, effectiveness check.

items: QC result tidak sama dengan QA disposition
Released status hanya oleh authorized QA
First-pass release dan release lead time

blocks.text: Batch-to-Recall
Recall dapat melakukan trace backward dan forward dalam hitungan menit, bukan pencarian manual lintas collection.

01 Signal Complaint, test, authority, supplier, trend. 02 Assess Severity, scope, risk, decision authority. 03 Hold Block affected lot/location/order immediately. 04 Trace backward FG → bulk → raw/packaging lot → supplier. 05 Trace forward Lot → transfer → shipment → shop/customer. 06 Execute Notify, return, segregate, reconcile, destroy/rework. 07 Close & CAPA Effectiveness, quantity reconciliation, authority report.
Retail, e-commerce, wholesale, distributor, dan partnership menggunakan lifecycle order yang sama dengan metadata channel—bukan model transaksi terpisah.
Order-to-Cash
Dari customer/order sampai fulfillment, invoice, payment, return, dan margin.

01 Customer/quote Identity, segment, price list, tax, credit, consent. 02 Sales order Channel, item, promotion, promise date, source reference. 03 ATP & reserve Available-to-promise, allocation, FEFO, backorder policy. 04 Pick-pack-ship Lot scan, packing, carrier, proof, delivery status. 05 Invoice/payment Tax, payment allocation, settlement, gateway reconciliation. 06 Return/refund RMA, reason, inspection, disposition, credit/refund.

items: Conversion, AOV, gross margin, return rate
Order cycle time dan fill rate

blocks.text: Controls
Measures

Integrasi Order, product, price/promo, availability, fulfillment, payment, consent, customer service, dan finance. Larangan Campaign tidak boleh membaca customer dump atau mengirim mass message tanpa consent, approval, idempotency, dan send ledger.
Finance menerima subledger event dari procurement, inventory, manufacturing, sales, payment, payroll, dan assets; bukan menghitung ulang transaksi dari laporan manual.
Record-to-Report
Setiap journal memiliki source, accounting date, dimension, rule version, dan reconciliation status.

01 Subledger event Receipt, invoice, issue, output, shipment, payment, payroll. 02 Accounting rule Account mapping, dimension, currency, tax, valuation. 03 Journal Balanced debit/credit, source reference, posting period. 04 Reconcile AP/AR/bank/inventory/COGS/payroll vs GL. 05 Close Cutoff, accrual, valuation, adjustment, lock period. 06 Report P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, margin, audit pack.

items: Chart of accounts dan financial dimensions
GL, AP, AR, bank/cash, tax, fixed assets
COGS saat fulfillment dan return reversal
Days to close, DSO, DPO, cash forecast

blocks.text: Boundary: desain accounting rule, tax, valuation, currency rounding, dan period close wajib disetujui Finance serta advisor pajak/audit yang relevan. ERP tidak boleh “membetulkan” uang dengan floating-point atau jurnal tanpa source.
HR adalah domain ber-PII tinggi. Data personal, performance, kesehatan/leave, payroll, dan akses sistem dipisahkan berdasarkan purpose.
Employee lifecycle
Effective-dated record menghubungkan organization, schedule, skill, approval, payroll input, dan system access.

01 Position/request Headcount, job, grade, budget, approval. 02 Hire/onboard Employee, contract, documents, orientation, access. 03 Time & leave Schedule, attendance, overtime, leave, correction. 04 Develop Skill, training, certification, performance, succession. 05 Payroll input Approved time, allowance/deduction, effective change. 06 Move/offboard Transfer/promotion, final clearance, access revoke, archive.

Draft Dapat diedit pembuat Submitted Siap direview Approved Komitmen resmi In execution Partial/progress Posted Ledger terbentuk Closed Selesai & reconcile Reversed Koreksi via dokumen baru

sections.title: Kontrol lintas modul & segregation of duties

blocks.text: Kontrol platform menghindari setiap modul membuat mekanisme approval, audit, numbering, file, dan permission sendiri.
RBAC + scope + limit
Permission action ditambah organization/site/warehouse/department scope dan amount/quantity approval limit.
Approval engine
Rule berversi, maker-checker, delegation ber-expiry, escalation, SLA, reason, dan evidence.
Immutable audit event
Actor, time, action, entity, before/after ter-redact, reason, source, correlation, device/IP context.
Idempotency & outbox
Unique operation key, transaction boundary, durable event, retry/backoff, dedup, dead-letter, replay.
Contract & inbox
Versioned API/event, signed webhook, incoming dedup, mapping, reconciliation, rate budget, circuit breaker.
File & e-signature
Private object storage, scan, retention, version, checksum, authorized download, signature evidence.
Konflik tugas yang harus dicegah
Membuat supplier/PO dan menyetujui PO atau mengubah rekening serta membayar.
Membuat transfer, menerima transfer sendiri, lalu menyetujui variance.
Melakukan test, mengubah result, dan merilis lot tanpa reviewer.
Mengeluarkan material, melaporkan output, dan menyetujui yield variance.
Mengubah price/discount, membuat order, dan menyetujui refund sendiri.
Membuat vendor, invoice, payment, dan bank reconciliation.
Mengubah role/employee sendiri atau menyetujui leave/overtime miliknya.
Developer production mengubah data dan menghapus audit/log tanpa kontrol.
Matriks ini menghubungkan kemampuan yang dibutuhkan, kondisi saat ini berdasarkan audit, target minimum, dependency, dan wave.

blocks.text: Wave mengikuti dependency bisnis. Timeline adalah rentang perencanaan dan dikalibrasi setelah discovery, kapasitas tim, serta kesiapan data.
Stabilkan sistem existing

blocks.text: Keputusan yang harus ditandatangani
Inventory ownership
Siapa pemilik balance, movement, reservation, lot, dan adjustment lintas channel?
Organization model
Legal entity, plant, warehouse, shop, channel, cost/profit center, timezone.
Quality authority
Pemisahan QC result, QA disposition, deviation, rework, destruction, dan recall.
Formula governance
Owner formula/BOM/spec, version approval, effective date, alternate, dan change control.
Financial policies
Currency/rounding, valuation, costing, tax, accounting date, dimensions, dan closing.
Commercial model
Satu order/customer lifecycle dengan channel metadata, price/promo, return, dan loyalty.
Privacy & retention
Data classification, consent, PII scope, archive, legal hold, deletion, dan historical access.
Build vs integrate
Fungsi mana inti StockWiz dan mana yang lebih tepat memakai layanan khusus melalui integration contract?
Accountability
Sponsor, product owner, domain owners, data owner, tech lead, control owner, dan KPI owner.
Langkah berikutnya

Jalankan workshop per value stream, validasi proses normal dan exception, tetapkan owner serta invariant, lalu pilih warehouse transfer sebagai vertical slice pertama. Blueprint ini menjadi business north star; implementation blueprint Opsi 3 menjelaskan cara memindahkan ownership modul secara bertahap.
